ios.desc:
Train without distractions. Riace. is a focused interval timer for athletes who want a reliable tool — not another fitness app cluttered with social feeds, subscriptions, and accounts.

Four modes cover every common interval pattern, and each one is configured directly on its home-screen card with intuitive scroll-wheel pickers. No extra screens, no buried menus.

FOUR MODES

- Tabata. Classic work/rest intervals. Configure work (5–120s), rest (5–60s), 1–20 rounds, and stack multiple sessions with a pause between them.

- Recover. Single-cycle timer with milestone markers along the way. Anything from 10 to 255 seconds, markers every 5–60s. Built for boxing rounds, rowing pieces, and active recovery circuits.

- EMOM. Every minute on the minute. Pick an interval (30–180s) and the number of rounds (1–30). The timer cycles automatically.

- Timer. A clean countdown from 30 seconds to one hour. For plank holds, rest periods, or anything that just needs a number ticking down.

HANDS-FREE CONTROL

Voice commands work in 6 languages: English, Italian, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese. The app detects your phone's language automatically, or you can pick one manually. Say "Go" to start, "Stop" to end, "Pause" to pause, or call a mode by name. Speak a number between 10 and 255 to set the Recover cycle duration on the fly. Rename any keyword from Settings.

Or use clap detection — a single or double clap (you choose) starts your Quick Start workout. Clap again to stop. Just the phone microphone, no extra hardware.

LOCAL ANALYTICS, ZERO ACCOUNT

Everything stays on your device. No account to create, no email to verify, no cloud sync, no subscription. Your workout history is yours, stored locally.

The Progress screen surfaces:
- Current streak and weekly average
- Monthly volume vs. last month
- Workout calendar with daily activity
- Activity chart by week, month, or year, filtered by mode
- Training split — how much time you spent in each mode
- Consistency score over the last 30 days
- Personal records: most Tabata rounds, most EMOM rounds, longest Recover session
- All-time totals across every mode

DESIGN

Dark interface throughout, optimized for low-light gym environments. Multiple colour presets for the Work / Rest / Pause palette. Portrait and landscape are both supported — the screen reflows automatically. Countdown audio is configurable: a beep, or a spoken "3, 2, 1, Go!".

NO SUBSCRIPTION, NO ACCOUNT

Riace. is free to use. No premium tier, no upgrade pr

quotes.text:
I always wanted to be a developer, and it was quite long time that I was planning to get fit and change my habits (smoke, fast food, alcohol, and so on)

I run a food business (American style potato rolls), and definitely I'm not a developer, even tho I've been working as project manager for a decade being the intersection between designers and developers. At the end of 2024 something changed in me, so I started my Project Riace to get fit, and while doing this I built an app that helped me on my plan.

Starting at 87.8 kg with 28% body fat, I'm now 72 kg with 11% body fat, without losing any muscles (actually I gained about 1kg) and this thanks to a nutritionist, a personal trainer and lot of tennis. No shortcuts, just eating well and training seriously each day, starting from 10 minutes each morning, every morning.

Why I'm telling you this? Because I'm in this new better version of me, thanks also to AI.

I trained Claude with my nutritional plan made by my doctor, my exercise made by my trainer, and my goal for this summer — it has been like having a 24/7 nutritionist and personal trainer in my pocket.

But, I'm here to show you the app I made, obviously called "riace." — it's an interval timer for workouts (tabata, emom, recovery, timer) with voice control, and a personal spin on the visual part to visualise the time spent training. It's a free app, no subscriptions, no account, nothing. Just your training side-kick, as it was for me.
